name: Candiac - Push Pull Legs / Upper Lower - 21:45

ex.note: 8-12 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. 21:45 local time at Anytime Fitness Candiac. First do 5 minutes of easy walking or cycling. Weeks 1-2: do only 2 work sets wherever 3 are listed. Flat dumbbell bench press. Use the two warm-up rows for easy ramp-up sets; enter your own loads. Keep feet planted and lower under control. Log the weight of ONE dumbbell. Swap: machine chest press.
8-12 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. Incline dumbbell bench press; use a low incline, about 15-30 degrees. Log ONE dumbbell. Swap: incline chest-press machine.
8-12 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. Seated dumbbell shoulder press with back support; avoid arching your lower back. Log ONE dumbbell. Swap: shoulder-press machine.
12-15 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. Dumbbell lateral raise; light weight, soft elbows, no swinging. Log ONE dumbbell. Swap: cable lateral raise.
10-15 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. Cable chest fly at mid-chest height; keep a soft elbow bend and a comfortable stretch. Log ONE cable stack. Swap: pec-deck fly.
10-15 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. Rope triceps pushdown; keep upper arms by your sides. Swap: straight-bar cable pushdown.

8-12 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. 21:45 local time at Anytime Fitness Candiac. First do 5 minutes of easy walking or cycling. Weeks 1-2: do only 2 work sets wherever 3 are listed. Lat pulldown to your upper chest, never behind your neck; avoid leaning back to swing. Swap: neutral-grip pulldown or assisted pull-up.
8-12 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. Seated cable row; keep your torso steady and pull toward your lower ribs. Swap: chest-supported row machine.
12-15 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. Reverse pec-deck fly for rear shoulders; keep chest against the pad. Swap: chest-supported dumbbell reverse fly.

10-15 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. Standing dumbbell biceps curl; curl both arms together without rocking. Log ONE dumbbell; one simultaneous curl is one rep. Swap: cable curl.
10-15 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. Dumbbell hammer curl with palms facing each other; curl both arms together. Log ONE dumbbell. Swap: rope cable hammer curl.

8-12 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. 21:45 local time at Anytime Fitness Candiac. First do 5 minutes of easy walking or cycling. Weeks 1-2: do only 2 work sets wherever 3 are listed. Goblet squat with one dumbbell at your chest; use a comfortable depth and keep your whole foot planted. Log the single dumbbell. Swap: leg press.

8-12 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. Dumbbell Romanian deadlift: soft knees, hips back, weights close; stop before your back rounds. Log ONE dumbbell. Learn the hinge with light weights. Swap: cable pull-through.
10-15 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. Seated leg curl; align knees with the machine pivot and lower slowly. Swap: lying leg curl.

10-15 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. Leg extension; align knees with the machine pivot and use a comfortable range. Swap: supported bodyweight squat, with no added load initially.

12-15 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. Standing dumbbell calf raise; both legs together, controlled stretch and a pause at the top. Log ONE dumbbell. Swap: standing or seated calf machine.

10-15 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. Floor crunch; curl your ribs toward your pelvis without pulling on your neck. Bodyweight only. Swap: dead bug, 8-10 slow reps per side.

8-12 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. 21:45 local time at Anytime Fitness Candiac. First do 5 minutes of easy walking or cycling. Weeks 1-2: do only 2 work sets wherever 3 are listed. Incline dumbbell bench press at about 15-30 degrees. Log ONE dumbbell. Swap: incline chest-press machine.
8-12 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. Seated cable row; steady torso and controlled lowering. Swap: chest-supported row machine.
8-12 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. Lat pulldown to upper chest; no swinging. Swap: neutral-grip pulldown or assisted pull-up.
12-15 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. Dumbbell lateral raise; use a light load without swinging. Log ONE dumbbell. Swap: cable lateral raise.
10-15 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. Dumbbell biceps curl, both arms together. Log ONE dumbbell. Swap: cable curl.
10-15 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. Rope triceps pushdown; keep elbows by your sides. Swap: straight-bar cable pushdown.

8-12 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. 21:45 local time at Anytime Fitness Candiac. First do 5 minutes of easy walking or cycling. Weeks 1-2: do only 2 work sets wherever 3 are listed. Dumbbell Romanian deadlift; hips back, soft knees, weights close, controlled range. Log ONE dumbbell. Swap: cable pull-through.

8-12 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. 45-degree leg press; keep hips and lower back against the pad and do not slam knees straight. Learn the safety catches before loading. Log added plates consistently; note the sled if known. Swap: goblet squat.
10-15 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. Seated leg curl; controlled lowering. Swap: lying leg curl.

12-15 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. Standing dumbbell calf raise, both legs together; pause at top and lower slowly. Log ONE dumbbell. Swap: standing or seated calf machine.
10-15 reps. Finish with 2-3 good reps left; do not train to failure. Floor crunch; controlled movement and relaxed neck. Bodyweight only. Swap: dead bug, 8-10 slow reps per side.
